issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export by resetting busy state
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function in `ExportButton` sets `busy` to `true` at the start of the export process but only resets it in the `.then()` callback, which only executes if the export succeeds. If the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx response), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button indefinitely. To fix this, the `setBusy(false)` call should be moved into a `.catch()` block or wrapped in a `.finally()` to ensure the button is re-enabled regardless of success or failure. This aligns with the issue description where the button stays greyed out after a failed export.
